text: The doctor examined me well and explained everything clearly. There's parking available on the roadside in front of the clinic.

author_name: สโรชา มัชกุล

text: The doctor is good at brains.
The treatment was excellent, and the diagnosis was accurate.

The meat is excellent, but the power goes out too often.
The staff are very friendly.
